confirmation.configuration: Select exact fresh completed passing backend evaluation after public read. No extra repetitions; repeatability unassessed.

execution_instructions: At most two independently physically evaluated structures including the same seeded reference. Additional generated T2 stencil candidates are mathematical preparation only and consume the same total math budget; they do not receive additional physical opportunities. Structure modification is optional. At most one NMPC optimization plus one replay per structure, at most two NMPC plus two replays total. A control-only solution is success. Frozen task: target [0.29,-0.035,0.19] m, zero initial state, 0.50 s, final [0.45,0.50] s hold, position <=0.010 m, speed <=0.020 m/s, tension per channel [0,8] N, control/sample 0.01 s, physics 0.0005 s. Soft weights do not replace acceptance. B and C share total Provider/science/solver/control limits. NMPC uses horizon=10, substeps=1, replan_period_s=0.1, max_iterations<=120 per solve, tolerance=1e-6; no arm may enlarge these computation limits. Before each evaluation the supervisor checks candidate recipe and per-structure opportunities against this protocol; an out-of-protocol run cannot support B/C comparison. Final evaluation requires 12 cells per segment and 8 N channel limits. Record actual costs and opportunities per structure, and compare only best found results. Before any repeat read research_history_index and state new information or reproducibility purpose. Historical evidence remains background; never count it as a current execution or SELECT. No new PPO. Full controls must cover this new task horizon. At first fresh complete final-fidelity pass publicly read and SELECT exact candidate/control/result with zero extra confirmations; otherwise publicly read and cite all_fresh_results before STOP. Session handoff requires existing admission and settled paired feedback. Stop at caps; no resets or extensions. This draft requires a new explicit scientific authorization before run. T2 is optional: read the current candidate mathematical_capabilities, choose one applicable authorized parameter and bounded h (optionally h/2), generate matched candidates and register each own initial-point GVS model. Use only validated current-Study model groups. One scale is a directional comparison, never a stable gradient. Choose modification, contrast, control optimization, diagnostics or no edit from actual direction_status; do not force unknown into a direction. Cite T2 in the original generate Plan with empirical_search and rerun T1 on the new candidate; old controls/scores confer no improvement or physical acceptance. B/C each have 22 total mathematical evaluations: five T1 model preparations cost 10, two-scale T2 costs up to 9, and one new-candidate T1 costs 2 (21 total); linearization-only preparation instead costs 5+9+2=16. All failed/reserved attempts remain charged; receipt reuse costs zero. B retains fixed_structure_reference and uses its equal math allowance for control/model research on that structure. A and the original frozen drafts are unchanged. This is a history-assisted paired draft; do not relabel it cold-start or import B outcomes into C.
